title: Workplace Surveillance Employee Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request information about workplace monitoring and protect your employee privacy rights. Know what data employers collect.
description: A formal letter template to request transparency about workplace surveillance practices from your employer. Helps employees understand what monitoring software is in use, what data is collected, and assert their privacy rights in the workplace.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject and Opening Statement
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Workplace Surveillance and Monitoring Practices

Dear [Manager/HR Director Name],

I am writing to formally request information about the surveillance and monitoring practices currently in place at [Company Name]. As an employee, I believe it is important to understand how my work activities and personal data may be monitored or collected during my employment.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request disclosure of the following information:

• What employee monitoring software or surveillance systems are currently installed on company devices?
• What types of employee activities, communications, or data are being monitored or recorded?
• Are personal devices used for work (BYOD) subject to monitoring, and to what extent?
• What specific data is collected, how long is it retained, and who has access to this information?
• Are there any keystroke logging, screen recording, or webcam monitoring capabilities in use?
• What are the company's policies regarding employee privacy and surveillance?

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Employee Rights
sections.content:
This request is made in accordance with my rights as an employee to understand workplace policies that affect my privacy. While I understand that employers have legitimate business interests in monitoring certain activities, I believe employees should be fully informed about the scope and methods of such surveillance.

I am also requesting copies of any written policies, employee handbook sections, or agreements related to workplace monitoring that I may have signed or should be aware of.

sections.heading: Privacy Concerns and Reasonable Expectations
sections.content:
I want to ensure that I am following all company policies while also maintaining appropriate boundaries between my work and personal activities. Understanding the extent of monitoring will help me:

• Use company devices and networks appropriately
• Protect my personal information and activities
• Comply with all workplace surveillance policies
• Make informed decisions about using personal devices for work purposes

sections.heading: Request for Timeline and Response
sections.content:
I would appreciate receiving this information within [timeframe] business days. If there are any forms I need to complete or procedures I should follow to obtain this information, please let me know.

I am happy to discuss this request in person or via email if you need any clarification about the information I am seeking.

sections.heading: Professional Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter. I look forward to your response and to maintaining a transparent working relationship regarding privacy expectations.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Your Job Title]
[Employee ID (if applicable)]
